correctness.rationale: For unit-rate absorbing pure-birth Qn the transient power-series coefficients c_k of R(h(z−1)) and absorbing-column tail b_k exactly characterize entrywise nonnegativity. The c0=2(3−h)/(h²+4h+6) sign forbids h>3; for 0<h≤3 an exact positive-amplitude sine expression for b_k has φ>π/12 and ψ>π/6, forcing a negative b_k at some k≤10 and thus forbidding all n≥12. Exact recurrence at h=3 gives positive required coefficients through index 9 and hence feasibility n≤11; small-step fifth Taylor coefficient excludes n≥6 near 0. For n6, b4 sign is quintic P with strictly positive derivative, yielding {0}∪[γ,3]. Independent SymPy exact matrix/recurrence checks passed. No claim of complete n7–11 safe sets.
